answer: The basalt test I would run is Vested mail carrier accreditation with mail carriers attestation: an accreditation carriers renew after round audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that an accreditation carriers renew after round audits — so privacy survives, and the harbor is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the grove of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
